erp.title: Connect rosters, punches, leave and overtime records to month-end review.
erp.description: Nexus plans to cover HR and attendance, as well as requisitions, procurement and inventory. We first review working-hour arrangements, data formats and IT responsibilities. Factories can self-host once the public version is released.

agent.title: Where the adoption assistant will fit
agent.description: A future website agent will use public documentation and factory requirements to help prepare deployment and data checklists. Answers will link to their documentation sources.

services.title: Responsibilities for open-source software and paid adoption.
services.description: After the public release, factories can adopt the software themselves or ask Asper for assistance. Both parties agree on scope and a quote before data migration, configuration, training and acceptance.

items.title: Migration and deployment
items.description: Review source formats, import scope and opening data, then plan deployment and acceptance.

items.title: Configuration and training
items.description: Review workflows with HR, managers and IT so the owners can complete an operational cycle.

items.title: Updates and maintenance assistance
items.description: Define responsibilities for backups, version updates and support according to your needs.

esg.title: Next, put the records to work for ESG delivery.
esg.description: Purchasing and inventory can provide part of the ESG data. A carbon inventory also needs fuel consumption and energy records. Product carbon footprints need product, process and allocation data. Asper assesses connections for the required outcome.

questions.title: Can we download the open-source version now?
questions.answer: The public version has not been released. Apache-2.0 is the planned license. You can assess workflow fit, data formats and preparation now. Downloads and installation documents will correspond to a released version.

questions.title: Does every factory with shifts fit?
questions.answer: Shift work is not the same as variable working-hour arrangements. The first release excludes Taiwan’s two-, four- and eight-week variable working-hour regimes. Asper reviews arrangements, shifts and punch formats before assessing fit.

questions.title: Do we need paid assistance to use the core?
questions.answer: After release, factories can use the core under its public license. Paid Asper work covers migration, configuration, training, acceptance and agreed support or maintenance.

questions.title: Can IT get installation and compatibility documents now?
questions.answer: First-release deployment requirements and compatibility are still being validated. Review data and maintenance needs first. Versioned installation, backup/restore and upgrade documents will accompany the release.

questions.title: Can we use ESG services with our existing ERP?
questions.answer: Start with existing ERP, spreadsheets or documents. An ESG project defines data needs for a specific deliverable, and your factory can keep its existing systems.

questions.title: How does Asper access a self-hosted factory’s data?
questions.answer: The factory manages its data. Adoption or ESG services require a separate agreement on authorized data, purposes and service scope.

contact.title: Assess fit while the public version is being prepared.
contact.description: Tell us one operational problem, your working-hour arrangements, shifts, punch format and IT responsibilities. An Asper team member reviews scope and preparation with you.

steps.title: The factory describes its needs
steps.description: Describe the operational problem, modules needed, working-hour arrangements, punch source and maintenance responsibilities.

steps.title: Asper reviews fit and preparation
steps.description: Asper reviews working-hour arrangements and data sources, then identifies applicable workflows, gaps and preparation tasks.

steps.title: Both parties agree on next steps

waste.title: Waste and recycling flows
waste.summary: A flow register for the period, a list of missing records, and batch evidence packs checked by your factory.
waste.audience: For factory operations, EHS, and ESG teams
waste.description: Asper links the available weight, handover, and treatment records, flags missing evidence, and prepares the agreed period or batch deliverables.

Agreed period, data sources, and contact for checks
outputs: Period flow register with source references
Missing records and items awaiting checks
Batch evidence packs checked by your factory
waste.nextStep: Tell us what your customer needs, the deadline, and the period or batches you want to cover. You can start the discussion with incomplete records.

waste.scope: Evidence packs use the records available and checked by your factory. Additional documents, certification, or verification require a separate scope and fee agreement.

carbon.title: Factory carbon inventory data preparation
carbon.summary: An activity data register, source and emission factor version records, and working papers for the agreed inventory scope.
carbon.audience: For ESG, finance, factory operations, and IT teams
carbon.description: Asper organizes activity data and supporting records for the agreed site, period, and emission sources. Both parties confirm the inventory boundary and emission factors before reviewing the working papers.
inputs: Site, period, emission sources, and inventory boundary agreed together
Fuel consumption, purchases, and opening and closing inventory
Electricity, other energy, and activity data and documents for agreed emission sources
Emission factor sources, versions, and supporting records agreed together
outputs: Activity data register with source references
Emission factor versions, data gaps, and check records
Inventory working papers for the agreed scope
carbon.nextStep: Tell us the site, period, customer deadline, and available energy or consumption records. We can confirm the inventory boundary and emission factors together later.
carbon.request: Provide carbon inventory data for a factory and period.
carbon.scope: Emission calculations, a formal inventory report, consultant involvement, and third-party verification are subject to a separate agreement on work, responsibilities, and fees.

pcf.title: Product carbon footprint data preparation (PCF)
pcf.summary: A product data and gap list, material and allocation settings, and a calculation data and evidence pack.
pcf.audience: For sales, product, and ESG teams
pcf.description: Asper starts with one product pilot and reviews the customer requirements, materials, production volumes, and process records. Both parties confirm the product boundary and allocation basis before Asper prepares calculation data.
inputs: Product, customer requirements, and product boundary agreed together
Bill of materials, consumption, supplier, and transport data
Production volumes, processes, and energy use records
Allocation methods, emission factors, and supporting records agreed together
outputs: Data requirements and gap list for the selected product
Checked material, process, and allocation settings
Calculation data and evidence pack for the agreed scope
pcf.nextStep: Tell us the product, customer requirements, deadline, and available material or production records. We can confirm the product boundary and allocation method together later.
pcf.request: Provide carbon footprint data for a selected product.
pcf.scope: Product emission calculations, a formal carbon footprint report, consultant involvement, and third-party verification are subject to a separate agreement on work, responsibilities, and fees.

questions.title: Do we need to adopt Nexus ERP first?
questions.answer: Keep your existing ERP and start with Excel files, documents, or authorized exports. Asper reviews the data and gaps before agreeing on an import or integration method.

questions.title: Can we start with incomplete data or undecided emission factors and allocation methods?
questions.answer: Start by explaining the customer requirements, deadline, site or product, and available data. We can confirm boundaries, emission factors, and allocation methods together later. The full data list is not needed for the first conversation.

questions.title: Are purchasing and inventory records enough for a carbon inventory or PCF?
questions.answer: They provide part of the data. A carbon inventory also needs energy, actual consumption, and activity data for the agreed emission sources. PCF also needs a product boundary, materials, production volumes, processes, and allocation basis.

questions.title: Does our ERP need an API connection?
questions.answer: We assess the connection method first. Based on export formats and data quality, both parties confirm whether CSV or Excel import or API integration is feasible, how updates will work, and who is responsible.

questions.title: Does delivery include emission calculations, formal reports, or third-party verification?
questions.answer: The listed data registers, working papers, and evidence packs are delivered within the project agreement. Emission calculations, formal reports, consultant involvement, and third-party verification require a separate agreement on work, responsibilities, and fees.

questions.title: How do we define the first paid project?
questions.answer: Confirm one delivery requirement, a contact, and a deadline, then choose a period, site, or product. Asper reviews available data and gaps before both parties agree on deliverables, scope, and pricing.
